item.title: The End of Oak Street Draws on an Enduring ’80s-Era Spielberg Formula
item.description: The new Warner Bros. science-fiction thriller, The End of Oak Street, imagines a suburban neighborhood mysteriously transported to prehistoric times, where the unfortunate inhabitants try (and mostly fail) to survive becoming a dinosaur’s dinner. But the presence of velociraptors isn’t the only quality of the film that feels like a product of another era. item.title: Children of Blood and Bone Deserves More Than Social Media Speculation
